svg.text: Real hand: XIAO RP2040 + HuskyLens + PCA9685 + 2 servos (breadboard)
Index and ring+little only. No thumb; middle motor not fitted. Servos on their own 5 V supply, never the laptop.
VCC = 3.3 V logic from the XIAO · V+ = servo power from the screw terminal only
NOT the laptop, NOT the XIAO 5V pin
plug: brown/black = GND at the bottom row
PCA9685 SDA (purple) → XIAO D4 (already wired by Anhad)
PCA9685 SCL (yellow) → XIAO D5 (already wired by Anhad)
PCA9685 VCC (orange) → XIAO 3V3 (logic only; jumper row 3 → row 11 on the right strip)
GND (black): XIAO GND, HuskyLens GND, PCA9685 GND → breadboard GND rail; supply − → PCA9685 terminal GND
5 V supply + (magenta) → 3 A fuse → PCA9685 screw terminal V+ (servo power)
HuskyLens VCC (red) → XIAO 5V (camera powered from the laptop through the XIAO, as now)
• Never join the external 5 V to the XIAO 5V pin or the PCA9685 header V+ pin: it back-feeds the laptop (§8.3 rule 1). Leave OE and header V+ empty.
• The grounds must meet: supply − and XIAO GND both reach the PCA9685 (its terminal GND and header GND are the same net), so servos and logic share 0 V.
• Leave CH0 (no thumb) and CH2 (middle, motor dead) empty. Tie the middle finger closed: the elastic holds it open, which makes 'rock' rude.
• Then: tools/xiao_check.py --servos → calibrate_finger index / ring_little → server.py --http --hand real. If the servo channels differ, tell the code.
• LEDs (D0), relay (D1) and ISD1820 (D2, D3) are not in this diagram. Breadboard rows a–e and f–j are each one connected strip.
